headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Tommy Troy has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a sprained right AC joint, effective retroactive to July 12, 2026. The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their roster, trading RHP Lance McCullers Jr., LHP Colton Gordon, and cash to the Milwaukee Brewers in exchange for outfielder Jadyn Fielder.

Several players have been affected by injuries and availability. Tommy Troy (Arizona Diamondbacks) has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a sprained right AC joint. Rob Zastryzny (Milwaukee Brewers) has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left trapezius strain. Drew Millas (Washington Nationals) has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 12, 2026, with a left index finger fracture. Other players on the injured list include Nick Mears (Kansas City Royals), Keegan Akin (Baltimore Orioles), Zac Gallen (Arizona Diamondbacks), Chris Martin (Texas Rangers), and Nick Lodolo (Cincinnati Reds).

The Astros have acquired outfielder Jadyn Fielder from the Brewers in a trade. The Brewers have also traded RHP Easton McGee to the Kansas City Royals for cash. Additionally, the Detroit Tigers have traded OF Jahmai Jones to the Boston Red Sox for a player to be named later.
